User_Journey: Mobile PLP - Page shell
TOM Description: Validate Mobile PLP page shell, quote context, and category tabs
Order_Steps:
1. Open the Siebel Start URL and login with the assisted UI credentials.
2. Open Application Menu and click Site Map.
3. Filter the Site Map with 'Sales Cal'.
4. Open the Sales calculator link.
5. Fill First name and Last name in the Sales calculator customer form.
6. Click Enter new customer details.
7. In Address lookup Search, enter a valid serviceable address (example: '177 pacific').
8. Select the suggested address result from the lookup list.

13. Open one compatible device card and verify it shows Selected.
14. Select an available storage option.
15. Select an available payment term.
16. Add Device Care when offered for the selected device.
17. Click Add to cart.
18. Observe the top message area and New services section.
19. Click Calculate Bundle & Save and wait for completion.
20. Click Create quote.
21. Click Create order.
Post_Verification:
- Message shown: "Cart updated".
- New service 1 is present in New services.
- Edit button is visible for the created service row.
- Tabs Mobile phones, Tablets & MBB, Bundles, Wearables, and Accessories are visible with Mobile phones active.
- User stays in Mobile PLP and is not redirected to Fixed PLP.
